en.content:
Generate scenes in Seedance 2.5 that require continuity over a long duration by explicitly listing actions in chronological order, such as “pick up a dropped wallet → they don’t notice even when called → catch up → tap them on the shoulder → remove their earphones → return the wallet,” in a 30-second one-shot.  
After generating with Seedance 2.5 in Dreamina, use editing features such as Intelligent Edit to create a workflow that doesn’t stop at generation, but includes revisions as well.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
【Dreamina × Seedance 2.5】
This time, I tried generating a sequence in a 30-second one-shot: “pick up a dropped wallet → they don’t notice even when called → catch up → tap them on the shoulder → remove their earphones → return the wallet.”

In AI video, it’s quite difficult to maintain continuity across people, props, physical contact, emotions, and ownership states like this, but Seedance 2.5 gives the impression that it can connect naturally even over longer durations. The ability to generate a 30-second one-shot is also truly unique.

In Dreamina, in addition to Seedance 2.5, editing-side features such as Intelligent Edit are also available, so I recommend a production workflow that doesn’t end with generation, but includes revisions as well.
#dreamina #dreaminapartner 
#seedance #dreaminaseedance25

zh.content:
30秒单镜头中，将“捡起掉落的钱包 → 呼喊也没注意到 → 追上去 → 拍肩膀 → 取下耳机 → 归还钱包”这类动作按时间顺序具体列举出来，用 Seedance 2.5 生成即使是长镜头也需要保持连续性的场景  
在 Dreamina 中，先用 Seedance 2.5 生成后，再使用 Intelligent Edit 等编辑功能，把流程做成不只是生成完就结束，而是包含修正环节的制作流程
